name: reclaim-ai
description: Connect to Reclaim.ai through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Official Reclaim MCP connected by URL through the Reclaim OAuth flow; Reclaim lists it for Starter, Business and Enterprise plans and documents only Claude clients. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256. Reclaim schedules on and writes back to the person's Google Calendar or Outlook calendar, so that calendar data reaches Kipster through Reclaim's cloud; kept because it is the person's own Reclaim account rather than an aggregator, and flagged as a third-party data flow.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
